status: Fixed display prototype before implementation/control/country output or route-accuracy evaluation
source: Qualified paid road field, unchanged coarse country/lake geography, original input and its separately priced connection. No graph weight/direction/turn/source identity or origin-policy change.
roadVsDisplay: Road routing remains the qualified incoming-arc field. Local display never feeds back into it, creates road junctions or supplies inter-road transfers. Display seeds are paid road positions and the input's checked local-access branch; local travel is an explicit 25kmh proxy, not verified local roads/access.
frame: Conservative envelope of input local radius plus full retained geometry of every active physical span, expanded by remaining local time at its earliest legal entry/source/endpoint. Clip to declared geography bounds. Full reached-vertex bounds alone are insufficient for frontier/loop geometry.
resolution: Start at 0.005 degrees and coarsen generically for extent/scratch/output caps; no place-specific precision. Entire current coverage at 0.025 degrees is 2454400 cells and fits the cap. Cell spacing is display resolution, not an accuracy bound.
landMask: Scanline country union with holes, subtract lake union with holes, preserving original membership semantics. Track every boundary-intersected cell with clipped supercover traversal. Local links need both centers on land; links touching boundary cells use the existing continuous polygon-crossing check with zero water-prefix tolerance. No channel can be skipped by point sampling.
localGrid: Eight-neighbor multi-source Dijkstra with upward whole-second 25kmh edge prices from the fixed coordinate-linear connector pricing rule. Exact minimum on this finite seeded grid; it is not exact road travel or a global continuous-area solver. Parent nibbles preserve paid local path witnesses.
roadSeeds: Sample each retained minor-great-circle road segment at no more than half the smaller cell width, with explicit endpoints and the exact source position. Resolve both directional prefixes and source rank through the qualified field, including frontier-only arcs and disjoint seed/regular intervals. A road sample only seeds its cell center after a priced continuous land link; in clear cells that follows from the boundary mask, otherwise check it directly.
coverageOnly: Reached road samples and the exact input also mark a separate coverage bit. It affects final approximate cell shading only and never propagates local travel. This preserves reached roads/bridges where generalized geography omits them without a water shortcut. Whole-cell road coverage can extend across a true shore; do not claim coastline truth.
workspace: Field maximum 57946526B backing plus bounded raster/link/parent/bitset/row/curve workspace remains <=67108864B. Reuse the field's vertex-summary buffer for the local heap when large enough, restoring every vertex summary from unchanged head labels/source afterward, including errors/retries. Use separate queue buffers only when the same total cap permits. Road labels are never overwritten. Reuse the raster bytes for final mask and contour-edge workspace after time probes.
boundEvidence: Every current source span has <=1837 source points, so a 4096-point temporary curve cap covers the existing frozen data. Current full source length/retained segment counts imply <30m samples at the finest supported CONUS spacing, even before horizon filtering. These are dataset/resource bounds, not ETA proof.
outputFallback: On named heap/contour/output complexity limits only, coarsen the whole grid by 1.25 up to 0.025 and retry using the same fixed workspace. At most nine attempts; no removed islands/holes or query replacement. Other errors remain failures. Report final spacing and every retry.
timingAndWitness: Capture field/display stages separately. Upward second entry/edge rounding is explicit model quantization. Later accuracy evaluation must use a frozen final ETA/witness rule consistent with local finish, retaining all 83/35 references and 166 path sums. Do not substitute unlabeled nearest-road pair timing for a different filled-area model.
controlsBeforeCountryOutputs: Mask/link equality with independent original geometry, overlapping polygons and holes
